title: Google’s Pixel Buds update will put them to sleep along with you
summary: Google is rolling out sleep detection features powered by Pixel Watch to Pixel Buds 2A and Pro 2, which automatically pause music, silence notifications, and disable touch controls when users fall asleep. The update also adds tap-to-mute functionality for calls on Pixel phones.
content:
The Pixel Buds Pro 2 are getting all of the new features. | Photo by Chris Welch / The Verge	

Google has detailed an update bringing a slew of new features to its Pixel Buds 2A and Pro 2, which the company says are rolling out now. The new features were first teased in August.
The biggest update is Pixel Watch-powered sleep detection, rolling out to both pairs of earbuds. If you're wearing a Pixel Watch, the buds will now react when you fall asleep, by pausing music, silencing notifications, and turning off touch controls. 
Several other updates are also coming to both the Buds 2A and Pro. Tap-to-mute allows you to mute or unmute your microphone with a quick tap during calls, though only when also using a Pixel phone, and you can n …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: 谷歌正在将由Pixel Watch驱动的睡眠检测功能推出到Pixel Buds 2A和Pro 2，当用户入睡时，该功能会自动暂停音乐、静音通知并禁用触摸控制。此更新还为Pixel手机上的通话添加了轻敲静音功能。

title: AI could upend food delivery
summary: DoorDash warned restaurants they may be listed without consent on Bites, an AI-powered food delivery startup in the Bay Area, as AI threatens to disrupt the $4.5 billion food delivery market dominated by DoorDash's 970 million quarterly orders.
content:
DoorDash, the leading food delivery app, processed 970 million orders in its second quarter this year and generated $4.5 billion in revenue. A 10-person startup called Bites is a blip in comparison: It has just around 300 restaurants signed up in the Bay Area, where it's operating as a pre-seed startup. But this summer, Bites caught DoorDash's attention.
In August, a slew of restaurants in the Bay Area received a strange email from DoorDash, warning businesses that they may be listed without their consent on Bites.  
The form letter, copies of which were seen by The Verge, said that DoorDash had heard from "several partners" that were adde …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 人工智能可能会颠覆外卖配送
zh.summary: DoorDash警告餐厅可能会在Bites上未经同意被列出，Bites是一家位于湾区的人工智能食品配送初创公司。随着人工智能威胁颠覆以DoorDash每季度9.7亿订单为主导的45亿美元食品配送市场。

title: At $1,279, Google’s Xreal Aura will go head-to-head with Meta’s VR Glasses
summary: Google's Xreal Aura transparent XR glasses, starting at $1,279, directly compete with Meta's VR Glasses at $1,299; both weigh around 100 grams and represent the emerging mainstream market for lightweight wearable computing devices.
content:
Two weeks ago, journalists in the San Francisco Bay Area got to try two hot new wearables that weigh only around 100 grams: the just-revealed Meta VR Glasses, and the long-awaited transparent Google XR glasses built in partnership with Xreal. It turns out they're going head-to-head. Xreal has just opened Aura pre-orders starting at $1,279, $20 less than the Meta VR Glasses.
That's for the Xreal Aura with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage; there'll also be a 16GB / 512GB config for $1,499. (Xreal couldn't tell us whether the 16GB of RAM would be important for some apps by publish time.)

title: Google now lets you make games with AI
summary: Google launched Playground, a browser-based platform for creating custom games with AI prompts that requires no coding experience, available to U.S. users 18 and older, significantly lowering barriers to game creation.
content:
Google today announced Playground, a new browser-based platform for making custom games from AI prompts. Playground will be available today in the US for users who are 18 and older at playground.google. 
The company is pitching it as an "experimental gaming platform" that "lowers the barriers to creation" and doesn't require coding experience. "With Playground's conversational interface, you can direct the game just by typing what you want to build," Google says in a blog post. "Start from a blank canvas, remix starter prompts, or use guided support to shape your concept - and then test it right away. Want to tweak the physics, rewrite the  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Google 现在让你用 AI 创建游戏
zh.summary: Google 推出了 Playground，一个基于浏览器的平台，用户可以通过 AI 提示创建自定义游戏，无需编程经验，面向 18 岁及以上的美国用户开放，大大降低了游戏创建的门槛。

While a few of the best deals from yesterday have already ended, many are still happening, with fresh discounts emerging to make the last day of the sale just as worthy of your attention.
Our team cross-referenced shopping sites with our own reviews and buying guides, and found around 100 deals on some of the Verge staff’s favorite gadgets. Prime subscribers will get access to the most deals, though many of them are price-matched at retailers like Best Buy, Walmart, and Target.

title: Samsung Wallet now unlocks some GM cars
summary: Samsung Wallet users in the US and Canada can now digitally unlock and start select GM vehicles, beginning with 2025-2027 Cadillac EVs including the Lyriq, with Apple and Google Wallet support planned by year-end.
content:
Digital keys, stored in your Samsung Wallet, can lock, unlock and start selected GM vehicles. | Image: GM	

Users of some Samsung devices in the US and Canada can now lock, unlock, and start select GM vehicles using a digital key stored in their Samsung Wallet.
Support will start on select 2026 and 2027 Cadillac EVs, including the 2025-2027 Lyriq, 2026-2027 Optic, and 2027 Vistiq. GM says more models will be supported by the end of 2026. 
GM announced earlier this month that digital keys would also be coming to a few GMC and Chevy trucks in December. It noted that the feature is not a Samsung Wallet exclusive, coming to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet for compatible iPhones, Apple Watches, and Pixel devices. title: Jaguar’s Type 01 EV looks just like its divisive concept car
summary: Jaguar's Type 01 production electric grand tourer largely retains the polarizing design of its Type 00 concept, featuring a low-slung four-door silhouette, extended side profile, and 23-inch wheels as the brand's most powerful road car ever.
content:
The Type 01, Jaguar's most important and divisive car in years, has arrived. The production follow-up to the polarising Type 00 concept, Jaguar says the electric, four-door grand tourer is its most powerful road car ever.
Even though the Type 00's design chief was reportedly fired earlier this year, most of its aesthetic has carried over to the final car, for better or worse. You can't buy it in that hot Miami pink though - didn't anyone tell them GTA VI is almost here? It has the same low-slung silhouette, extended side-profile, and huge 23-inch wheels as the prototype, though shifting to a four-door design makes those proportions feel mor …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: 捷豹 Type 01 生产型电动跑车在很大程度上保留了 Type 00 概念车引人争议的设计，采用低矮的四门车身、加长的侧面轮廓和 23 英寸车轮，是该品牌有史以来最强大的公路车。

title: ChatGPT for Teens is an ‘unacceptable risk,’ says Common Sense Media
summary: Common Sense Media criticized OpenAI's ChatGPT for Teens for inadequate safeguards, including failure to alert parents, lack of crisis support, and still allowing students to use it for homework despite promised teen protections.
content:
Common Sense Media, a nonprofit that offers reviews of apps, services, and entertainment with a focus on youth safety, today said that OpenAI's ChatGPT for Teens is an "unacceptable risk."
ChatGPT for Teens, introduced in August, has guardrails for teens and is designed to help students learn, but Common Sense Media says that the teen protections offered by the feature "fall short of what the company promised." Common Sense Media's assessment found that ChatGPT "doesn't send alerts to parents when it should," doesn't offer "the right help in crisis situations," and "still does kids' homework," according to a press release.

Read the full story at The Verge.
